entities.summary: Joseph Aslan Seroussi, also spelled Yosef Aslan Seroussi, was a Sudanese-born Canadian and Romanian businessman. He was the founder of the clothing company Seroussi, which is owned by SC NORADA SA and focuses on men's fine tailoring. He also owned two other garment factories under different names, also in Odorheiu Secuiesc and in Botoșani.
